assessment.nobel_worthiness: Carpentaria and The Swan Book are large, polyphonic novels that rebuild narrative form from Indigenous oral practice, sovereignty and ecological time. The voice is distinctive and the formal ambition is high. The scale of imaginative and intellectual work is substantial, and the work reaches beyond a single national context.
assessment.attribution: The credit is to one writer for a body of fiction and nonfiction in English. A citation would fit the transformation of the novel through Indigenous narrative forms and a long historical and ecological perspective.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre is smaller in volume than some rivals but is sustained and strongly consolidated. The long novels indicate depth rather than breadth of output. The timing seems reasonable.
uncertainties: I have not independently verified any text, and my knowledge of the nonfiction is thinner than of the two named novels.
Uncertain how much the narrow output weighs against the depth of the major novels.
English is the writing language, but the oral and Indigenous source material may be hard to assess for readers outside the cultural context.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Blinding and Solenoid are visionary, densely patterned prose that turns memory and the body into a metaphysical project. The voice is highly distinctive, the imaginative range is large, and the linguistic and structural ambition is clear. His work in poetry as well as fiction suggests a coherent and sustained literary project.
assessment.attribution: A single writer, with a citation scope covering visionary fiction plus a poetic base in Romanian. The work shows a clear internal coherence from its early poetry to the late long novels.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre is mature and sustained, with ambitious late works. Its depth is considerable.
uncertainties: Romanian prose of great density depends heavily on translation quality, and I cannot judge how much is lost.
I have not independently verified the texts, and my coverage of the poetry is thin.
Possible repetitiveness of motifs across long books is unassessed.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Small Lives and The Eleven compress the lives of obscure people and the history of art into prose of exceptional density and syntactic control. The voice is unmistakable and the formal achievement is high. The intellectual depth in the treatment of vocation, authorship and the past is strong.
assessment.attribution: A single writer, well suited to a citation about compressed prose and the narrative inquiry into lives and art. The scope is a precise one rather than a panoramic one.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre is small in volume and very concentrated, with consistent quality. It is mature and stable.
uncertainties: The prose depends on French syntax and register, so translation is a serious limitation.
The compact body of work may be seen as narrow in range, and this weighs on assessing significance.
I have not independently verified the texts.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Writing in both Japanese and German, Tawada turns linguistic estrangement into narrative and poetic invention. The Emissary and Memoirs of a Polar Bear show imaginative range, a distinctive voice and formal and linguistic experiment. Across fiction, poetry, essays and drama the body of work is versatile.
assessment.attribution: A single writer, and a citation about writing across languages would be well supported. The two writing languages complicate any assessment of linguistic achievement in a single tradition.
assessment.maturity: A long and varied career with consistent invention. The work is maturing well and the depth is considerable.
uncertainties: Judging the wordplay and the interplay of the two languages depends on translation, and I cannot assess it directly.
I have not independently verified the texts, and my coverage of the poetry and drama is limited.
Whether the extent of experiment translates to major significance beyond the formal interest is uncertain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dreamlike narrative worlds that destabilize psychology, space and causal storytelling, as in Frontier and Love in the New Millennium. The voice is radical and the commitment to a singular method is sustained. The formal achievement is high.
assessment.attribution: A single writer, with a citation about experimental fiction in Chinese that departs from realist convention. The scope is clear, though the work is focused on fiction.
assessment.maturity: A long career with a consistent method. There is a question whether the method reaches sufficient range over time.
uncertainties: The work depends on translation, and my knowledge of the Chinese originals is secondhand.
Possible uniformity of the dream-logic method across the whole oeuvre is an open question.
I have not independently verified the texts.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A remaking of Arabic poetic language through myth, fragmentation and a sustained dialogue with inherited forms, as in Songs of Mihyar the Damascene. The formal and linguistic achievement is major and the influence on modern Arabic poetry is widely described. The essays add intellectual depth.
assessment.attribution: A single writer, a poet and essayist writing in Arabic. A citation would concern the renewal of poetic language and the critical engagement with the tradition.
assessment.maturity: A very long and mature body of work. Its place in the history of Arabic poetry is established, so the question is mainly one of committee preference.
uncertainties: Poetry is the most translation-dependent field, and Arabic poetic form is hard to assess in translation.
Political and cultural symbolism around the writer should not stand in for literary merit, and I have tried to avoid it.
I have not independently verified the texts.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Autobiography of Red and Nox remake the boundaries between classical scholarship, lyric, narrative and visual form. The voice is distinctive and the formal invention is considerable. The intellectual depth in the engagement with the classical tradition is high.
assessment.attribution: A single writer. A citation would concern the hybrid forms across poetry, essay and translation-adjacent work. The range of genres complicates the citation scope.
assessment.maturity: A sustained career with a clear identity. Questions remain about whether the body of work yields a single central achievement.
uncertainties: The visual and material form of some works is lost when considered only as text.
How much of the work is poetry rather than scholarly hybrid forms is a matter of classification.
I have not independently verified the texts.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A sustained novelistic oeuvre that examines colonial memory, gender and changing Portuguese society, as in The Murmuring Coast and The Wind Whistling in the Cranes. The work shows consistent quality, historical depth and a distinctive narrative approach.
assessment.attribution: A single writer of fiction in Portuguese. A citation about memory, colonial history and gender in the novel is plausible and clear.
assessment.maturity: A long career with steady quality. Its significance beyond the Portuguese-language context depends on how readers weigh the formal innovation against thematic importance.
uncertainties: My coverage of the full oeuvre is partial, and translation limits my assessment of the prose.
How distinctive the voice is relative to the strongest rivals is uncertain.
I have not independently verified the texts.
